title: Human-only sessions (Teams, phone, PEP RDP, mail, Staging, smartPEP, externals)

where.teams: ct-zinc-master + Teams client (Azure dev tenant wr7g0)
where.pep-rdp: DM-X / DM-Y PEP desktop over RDP, under the env's PEP lock
where.externals: GCP Pub/Sub access; CT tenant1 + Careanesth test system

env.note: no worker prompts: the runner prints the session checklist (manual <run> --session <name>) and writes the testers' results as rows

families.name: MS Teams session
families.note: after the shared group's HPN-26 GO

families.name: PEP RDP session
families.note: every RDP block holds locks/<env>~pep (holder '<name>/manual'); AUT-19 only inside W-Y-MSG (HARD, DM-Y; listed in the auth and ops group.json, not repeated here)

families.name: Staging Beekeeper session
families.note: Staging is on the production cluster: humans only, no agent, no harness

gates.check: testers named per session and present; the runner session that writes the rows is running
teams: shared HPN-26 says GO (Teams enabled, ≥ 1 HP linked or resettable, flag known); owners of ct-zinc-master informed (link resets, booking mail)
pep-rdp: the tester has an OPERATOR share and an own RDP reveal of DM-X / DM-Y, and takes locks/<env>~pep before each RDP block
staging: a human with Staging access and the Beekeeper test-tenant credentials from the store; no Claude session touches Staging

seed.note: session preparation: testers, devices, accounts, consents, dashboard rows

cleanup: Teams links of the tester users as agreed with the ct-zinc-master owners
PEP RDP: created employees / users (AUT-19) deleted; PEP locks released
booking mail flag on ct-zinc-master back to its value (owners)
no tester credential in any file or row
